overview: Extract ListsTabViewModel from ListsTabView (436 lines). View manages list/group CRUD across 6 alert dialogs, context menus, delete cascade, drag reorder, and group expand/collapse. VM takes all business logic and dialog state.
goals: Create @Observable ListsTabViewModel owning list CRUD, group CRUD, delete cascade, drag reorder, group assignment, expand/collapse persistence
Reduce ListsTabView from ~436 lines to ~200 lines
All 6 alert flows become testable without UI presentation
nonGoals: No changes to list/group models or sort order algorithm
successMetrics: ListsTabViewModel.swift created with all CRUD, reorder, and dialog state methods
rules: View holds @Query, passes data to VM via update()
VM owns all dialog state (booleans + optionals for each alert)
VM persists group expand/collapse to UserDefaults
